fact: The Herald reports the electronic Government Procurement (eGP) system, launched in October 2023, was in use by 31 March 2024, with PRAZ saying it automates bid submission, evaluation and communication.
PRAZ chief executive Clever Ruswa says over 9,900 suppliers and over 380 procuring entities had registered on the eGP platform by 31 March 2024.
The Herald reports PRAZ's electronic Government Procurement (e-GP) system became operational on 1 January 2024, with bidders submitting documents online.
The Herald reports the eGP system, launched by President Mnangagwa in October 2023, became operational on 1 January 2024 and lets all public entities and bidders run procurement electronically.
PRAZ upgraded the e-GP system to Phase 1.3 in early 2025, covering e-evaluation, e-award, e-contract management, framework agreements and management information reports, for all public entities.
